title: Google Home Presence State Mismatch
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=googlehome:event event_type=presence_sync
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(presence_state) as presence_states, count as updates by person _time
| where updates>2 AND presence_states>1
| sort - updates
description: Uses Google Home presence sync events telemetry to monitor days where household presence bounced between conflicting states in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for presence automations that are likely to misfire, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Google Home presence sync events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Daily person table of updates and distinct states.
grandmaExplanation: It blends days where household presence bounced between conflicting states so you can spot presence automations that are likely to misfire before it becomes annoying.
